claims.text: GDACS assessed an Orange alert for a forest fire in Greece covering the period 31 July-4 August 2026, citing approximately 18,299 hectares burned and about 1,648 people in the fire-affected area, noting the fire "can have a medium humanitarian impact based on the burned area and the affected population and their vulnerability."

GDACS's event report (GDACS ID WF 1029987, Glide number WF-2026-000142-GRC) as of 5 August 2026 states: 'Forest Fire (18419 ha) in Greece 31 Jul 2026 ... Start Date - Last detection*: 31 Jul 2026 - 05 Aug 2026. Duration (days): 5. People affected: 1648 in the burned area. Burned area: 18419 ha.' The alert level remains Orange ('Forest fire can have a medium humanitarian impact based on the burned area and the affected population and their vulnerability'); no containment or resolution has been declared.

Re-checked 9 August 2026: GDACS's event report (WF 1029987) remains at episode 18 (31 Jul-5 Aug 2026 window, 18,419 ha burned, 1,648 people affected), with no newer episode published and no thermal-anomaly detection since 5 August — four consecutive days with no new hotspot activity — indicating the fire is now contained.

description: A wildfire broke out on 31 July 2026 near Psatha and Porto Germeno in western Attica, west of Athens, amid a European heatwave, spreading rapidly under strong winds and prompting evacuations and sea rescues along the coast. GDACS assessed an Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact, with the burned area growing to about 18,419 hectares and roughly 1,648 people in the fire-affected area. The fire's thermal anomaly was last detected on 5 August 2026; after four consecutive days with no new hotspot activity, the fire is considered contained.

impact.summary: GDACS's final assessment (episode 18, covering 31 July to 5 August 2026) records about 18,419 hectares burned and roughly 1,648 people in the fire-affected area, under an Orange alert for medium humanitarian impact. No thermal anomaly has been detected since 5 August, indicating the fire is contained.

location.region: Western Attica (Psatha, Porto Germeno), west of Athens

name: Wildfire — Western Attica, Greece

updates.text: With no thermal-anomaly detection since 5 August — four consecutive days without new hotspot activity — GDACS data indicated the fire was contained.

GDACS's episode 18 update extended the observation window to 5 August and put the burned area at 18,419 hectares, up from 18,299 hectares as of 4 August, with about 1,648 people in the fire-affected area.
